meta.name: seo-subdomain
meta.description: Subdomain ownership map for a domain. Lists subdomains, queries overview/keywords/competitors/backlinks per subdomain, surfaces which subdomains own which topic clusters, where there's fragmentation, and whether consolidation is warranted. Use when the user asks "subdomain analysis", "subdomain ownership", "subdomain SEO", "blog vs main domain", "support vs docs subdomain", or "should I consolidate subdomains".

copy.tagline: 分析子域名所有权与SEO表现，发现内容碎片化
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果管理多个子域名，想评估是否该合并它们以提升SEO效果。
